exclusions: Exact Utah special statute and all offense, nexus, age, completion, and exclusion conditions
routes.notes: The expungement follows from the Board's own order and process, so the product gives status and correction guidance rather than selling a petition.

routes.statute: Utah Code Title 77, Chapter 40a trafficking provisions
